payload.supporting_quote: We observed that patients with impaired verbal memory and overall CI showed increased CSF KFLCs

payload.comparison_population: nonselected controls (including noninflammatory CNS disorder controls and other inflammatory CNS disorders)
payload.supporting_quote: KFLC biomarkers are efficient tools to separate patients with MS from controls, even when compared with other patients with CNS autoimmune disorder.
A KFLC index of 11.56 best separated MS from OIND, with similar performances than OCB
KFLC index and KFLC IF had similar performances in diagnosing MS from nonselected controls and OIND ... and performed better than CSF KFLC
The 1 mg/L cut-off yielded a percent agreement of 86.1% and Cohen's kappa value of 0.8. Youden's index, yielded a cut-off of 0.92 mg/L as optimal (90.3% specificity and 90.9% sensitivity).

payload.comparison_population: other neuroinflammatory disorders and non-inflammatory groups
payload.supporting_quote: The KFLC index and the KFLC intrathecal fraction performed as well as OCB; no cases were missed when KFLC was mandatory to achieve a MS diagnosis.
